headline: Battery-electric vehicles went from 8.4% of Australian new-vehicle sales in January 2026 to 24.9% in August — the first month on record that BEVs outsold petrol.

stats.label: BEV share of new-vehicle sales, August 2026 — a record, and the first month battery-electric cars outsold petrol.
BEVs delivered in August 2026, against 7,316 in January — roughly 3.7× in eight months.
Electrified share of August sales (BEV + PHEV + hybrid). Combustion-only cars became the minority.
Battery-electric share in NSW, Q2 2026 — the ACT leads at 40.1%, the Northern Territory trails at 7.3%.

notes: Electrified share counts battery-electric, plug-in hybrid and conventional hybrid together; BEV-only figures are the ones used in the two charts.
Monthly shares differ slightly between aggregators because some exclude brands that do not report to VFACTS or to the EVC. Figures here follow the FCAI VFACTS series as reported by the sources above.
Registration data is a lagging indicator of the sales floor. The leading indicators worth watching are EV finance applications (CBA reported a 161% rise from March 2026) and used-EV auction volumes.
